title: empty-string-reconciliation-then-if (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: After array and empty paths exit, a nonempty string or exception remains; the subsequent string check has both reachable outcomes.

allowed.reason: Documented Psalm policy warns when falsy null or an object-only-truthy alternative is combined with strings that can be both truthy and falsy. This does not claim the guard is impossible. https://psalm.dev/docs/running_psalm/issues/RiskyTruthyFalsyComparison/

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago agrees with the scoped expectation.
